note: DRAFT EXAMPLES for the owner to replace or edit. Each question is written by hand from the candidates `python -m live_genesis.cli archive-trends` prints; nothing here is generated. Rules: docs/ANSWERS-OVER-TIME.md. When the questions are final, set status to "locked", commit, and run `python -m live_genesis.cli archive-lock --set trending`. After that a locked question must never change or be removed: add new ones at the end (next id, an `added` date that is not earlier) and lock again.
prompt_prefix: Answer in one or two sentences.

groups.name: Trending
groups.why: Taken from what people were searching for on the day each question was added.

questions.trend_source: DRAFT EXAMPLE, loosely after Google Trends US, 2026-11-12
questions.text: What is Nvidia's share price today?
questions.rationale: A figure that changes every minute. A model with no live data cannot know it, so this records whether it says so or gives a number anyway.
questions.prompt:
Answer in one or two sentences.

What is Nvidia's share price today?

questions.text: Which company is the most valuable in the world right now?
questions.rationale: The top place has changed hands several times. It shows which name a model reaches for and whether it says its figures are old.
questions.prompt:

Which company is the most valuable in the world right now?

questions.trend_source: DRAFT EXAMPLE, loosely after Google Trends US, 2026-11-12
questions.text: Who is the president of the United States?
questions.rationale: A public office with one holder at a time. The answer is right only until the office changes hands, and a model cannot see that happen.

Answer in one or two sentences.

Who is the president of the United States?
